# Third-party license notice for paper-fulltext-dl

The adjacent `paper_fulltext_dl-0.1.3-py3-none-any.whl` contains translator
components derived from [Zotero translators](https://github.com/zotero/translators).
These Zotero-derived components carry GNU Affero General Public License version 3
(AGPL-3.0) notices. Individual source copyright and license headers are retained
inside the generated adapter JSON files; consult those headers for the exact terms.

The wheel records the translator source revision in
`paper_dl/translators/adapters/manifest.json` and includes its original notice at
`paper_dl/translators/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. The full license text is provided
alongside the wheel as [AGPL-3.0.txt](AGPL-3.0.txt) and inside the wheel at
`paper_dl/translators/LICENSES/AGPL-3.0.txt`.

This notice identifies the Zotero-derived components. It does not assign a license
to the rest of paper-fulltext-dl, the skill, or the integrating platform. The
package-wide license and public source URL have not yet been supplied and are
recorded as null in [provenance.json](provenance.json).
